notes: FullLoader could still be driven to execute arbitrary code through python/object/apply style tags. Code that only ever calls yaml.safe_load is unaffected, which is the common case and exactly the distinction a version-range scanner cannot make. Note that safe_load() internally calls load() with SafeLoader, so a naive call-graph walk appears to reach the vulnerable symbol; safe_wrappers records that this entry point is the documented fix, not a path to the bug.
reviewer_note: safe_load/SafeLoader deliberately excluded from symbols and listed as safe_wrappers instead - they were never affected.
